name: adif-to-qsl-label
description: Offline-first ADIF to printable QSL label and card helper

scripts.lint: eslint app-core.js scripts tests playwright.config.js && node scripts/check-inline-js.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write app-core.js scripts tests playwright.config.js eslint.config.js package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md docs .github vendor/README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check app-core.js scripts tests playwright.config.js eslint.config.js package.json README.md CHANGELOG.md docs .github vendor/README.md
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
